206-339-677-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
206-339-677-7272.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

Cast Essence Flux by tapping Warden of the Eye due to Essence Flux's convoke ability, blinking Warden of the Eye.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

62-2105-3337.description:
Activate Reflection of KIki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare Savage Ventmaw and Combat Celebrant token as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
When you attack, Savage Ventmaw and the Combat Celebrant token trigger.
Resolve the token's trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve Savage Ventmaw's trigger, adding mana.
Repeat.

483-1981-2415-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3532-3836-5078-7737.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it's attached to
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

392-1494-6822-7720.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Harnfel by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Lyla triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1170-2440-4720-7517.description:
Cast the copy of Aqueous Aria spell from exile by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, flickering Campus Composer, which enters prepared.
When Campus Composer enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}.
Resolve the spell from step 1, creating a 3/3 Elemental creature token with flying.
When the token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Elemental you control.
Pay an additional {2}{U} to repeat steps 1 through 5 an additional time, this time adding {C}{C}{C} from the Mana Echoes triggers.
Pay an additional {1}{U} to repeat the loop again, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Pay an additional {U} to repeat the loop again, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Pay an additional {U} to repeat the loop again, adding six {C}.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding one colored mana.
Repeat steps 1 through 5 and step 10 any number of times.
1170-2440-4720-7517.notes: Mana needed drops significantly for each additional Merfolk, Bard, and Elemental you control.

224-1362-1772-2653.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm and Nissa trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
224-1362-1772-2653.notes: Nissa will also find a single Elf or Elemental from your library and put it into your hand.

3734-4004-7149.description:
Cast Phyrexian Metamorph by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Phyrexian Metamorph into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Phyrexian Metamorph dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Turtle, gaining its abilities.
When Phyrexian Metamorph enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Phyrexian Metamorph leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Phyrexian Metamorph from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

You have max speed.
You control an additional creature.
1765-4050-6290.description:
Cast Lightwheel Enhancements either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {W}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Lightwheel Enhancements enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with Lightwheel Enhancements attached, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1491-6218-6723-7267.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

985-5078-7010.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1127-4067-5922.description:
Activate Helga by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W} that can only be spent to cast creature spells with mana value 4 or greater or creature spells with {X} in their mana cost.
Cast Blinking Spirit by paying {3}{W}.
Helga triggers, causing you to draw a card, gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Helga.
Activate Blinking Spirit by paying {0}, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Helga.
Repeat.
1127-4067-5922.notes: If you have enough leftover mana to cast the creature, you can instead substitute untapping another permanent instead of Helga.

465-2292-6132.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

4375-4659-5361.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Auton Soldier enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Auton Soldier.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

645-804-1267-6797.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-804-1267-6797.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a legendary copy of Medomai the Ageless whose name is still Sakashima the Impostor.
Deal combat damage using Sakashima the Impostor.
Sakashima the Impostor triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sakashima the Impostor
Repeat each turn.

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar

Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.

Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.

When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.

Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

Repeat.

2511-2961-6553.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, False Demise triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1799-4050-5359-5795.description:
Activate Barkform Harvester by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk and the Gnomes, adding {4}.
Repeat.

1617-4831-4983-5358-5399.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
Pirated Copy on the battlefield as a copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
1617-4831-4983-5358-5399.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur trigger twice.
Resolve both Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having Cacophodon fight Bellowing Aegisaur and Pirated Copy to ensure neither dies due to lethal damage.

3000-3025-5670.notablePrerequisites:

When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance's second ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.

Deal 2 damage to that opponent by any method, reduced to 1 due to Protection of the Hekma.
Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 7.

At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder's second ability triggers, blinking Glorious Protector.
Glorious Protector leaves and enters the battlefield, returning Icewind Stalwart from exile to the battlefield, and triggering Soulherder's first ability, as well as Icewind Stalwart and Glorious Protector's enters-the-battlefield abilities.
Resolve the Soulherder trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Glorious Protector trigger, exiling Icewind Stalwart until Glorious Protector enters the battlefield.
Soulherder's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart trigger, blinking Glorious Protector.
Repeat from step 2.

215-1701-3676-4050-5176.description:
Cast Spire Golem by paying {0}.
Radagast and Spireroot trigger.
Resolve the Spireroot trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Radagast trigger, creating a 3/3 Beast creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Beast, adding {1}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Spire Golem from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

176-560-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Queen Allenal of Ruadach.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

238-2533-4050.notablePrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
238-2533-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gerrard, adding one mana of any color.
Gerrard dies, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gerrard trigger, returning all artifact and creature cards put into your graveyard this turn to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-2577-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gravecrawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Gravecrawler dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
